quest.title: The Sun's Gilded Apple
quest.description: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: I see. The fragment lies within the garden — more precisely, within the great tree there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's go have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there! Would it be all right if we went in and looked around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we're visiting from somewhere far, far away, and we've never seen a garden as wonderful as this one before...

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: Ah, visitors from a distant land. Thank you for the compliment. When Larisa was still alive, she would come by often for some work here and there. The plants all thrived under her care.

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: At that time, that big tree over there would bear the biggest, most beautiful fruits. But after she left us for good, no matter how or what I tried, that tree would simply bear fruit no more...

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: But there is more to this garden than that tree, wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, do you think we can get in there? For, uh, you know, a closer look at its beauty?

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: Ha, I'm afraid not.

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: The garden is currently under maintenance, and no one's allowed in there except the fae help. I apologize, but rules are rules.

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: But you are absolutely welcome to look at the garden from here. Didn't you say that you come from a distant land? You can tell me some stories while you admire the view.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just hold on a sec, please!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Paimon pulls you aside so that the Snegovik standing guard won't hear you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... He had Paimon thinking for a second that he was gonna let us in! And then he said no! What are we gonna do now???

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, how about we skirt around and see if we can climb over a wall somewhere?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, but it's gonna look a little weird if the both of us disappear at the same time. That's gonna raise an eyebrow, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then I'll have to trouble you to occupy him for a little while, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Mine?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know that I'm not the chatty type.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true... Well, you can leave it to Paimon then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it's got to be a quick in-and-out, you hear? Even Teyvat's best guide has only so many stories to tell...

talks.objective: Sneak into the garden to recover the fragment

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: Well then, little one. Tell me more about what it's like out there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #({NICKNAME}, just like we planned, Paimon'll keep him talking. You sneak around from the side!)

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: ...Wow, I never knew that. I really learned something new today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, that's right... Oh look, Paimon's friend is here. Gotta go. We, uh, have something to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Ladon
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. It's been great talking to you. Please come back to visit when you have the time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh... sure...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did I interrupt something? You two seemed to be having a good time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ugh, you're finally back, {NICKNAME}! This is the first time ever Paimon's gotten tired from all that talking...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's got to rest and talk a little less for now... Yes. That's what Paimon's going to do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Paimon's got the guard distracted... Now's my chance to find another way into the garden.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Flowers and grass, all the way up here? Is this really still the snowy mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: I feel it... The presence is getting stronger. The fragment of power is here.
